# ONNX Runtime C API headers

Unmodified headers for ONNX Runtime 1.32.0 (C API 32), published by Microsoft in
`Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime` 1.32.0 on NuGet. The Python wheel contains the native
runtime but no C headers; bundling the matching headers keeps builds independent
of GitHub availability. Only the three headers needed by the C API are included.
The upstream license is in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.ml.onnxruntime/1.32.0/microsoft.ml.onnxruntime.1.32.0.nupkg
